summary: The T11 implementation conforms to the saved plan: it adds a deterministic awf-install-manifest.json generator with version/channel/source metadata, pinned GitHub Release artifact URLs, sha256 validation, platform metadata, reserved signatures, and generated_at control; it extends the existing publish workflow while preserving python-distribution-sha256.txt; it documents manifest inspection, pinned URL policy, channel semantics, checksum verification, H01, and future signing; and it adds focused generator, workflow, docs, and channel/version tests. Existing validation evidence in plans/T11_INSTALL_MANIFEST_VALIDATION.md records the required focused red/green pytest, ruff, format, workflow regression, and CLI sanity checks while leaving broad AWF/GitHub validation to AWF after agent completion.
